description: Holds one room for its offer_id alone (from search_hotels or get_hotel) for 30 minutes and returns booking_id, booking_secret (shown once: keep it to read or cancel the booking), the confirmed total (price_changed and previous_total when the hotel repriced it), the cancellation terms, expires_at and pay_url. No key needed. Nothing is ever charged by a tool and no tool handles a card: the guest pays on the pay_url page, in Nuitee's card form, and the booking exists only after that payment. Give the guest pay_url with the total and the terms. Guest details are optional: send all four (name as on the ID shown at check-in, email, phone with country code) or none, and the guest enters them on the pay page. The same idempotency_key returns the same hold instead of a second one.

adults.description: Adults in the one room, 1 to 8. Default 2.

checkin.description: Optional; if sent it must match the offer.

checkout.description: Optional; if sent it must match the offer.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for the prices, default EUR.

expected_total.description: With a key: the total you saw for this offer, so a change is flagged. Ignored without a key; the price is always the partner's.

guest_email.description: Where the confirmation goes after the guest pays. Only an address the guest gave you for this.

guest_first_name.description: As on the ID shown at check-in.

guest_last_name.description: As on the ID shown at check-in.

hotel_id.description: Optional; if sent it must match the offer.

idempotency_key.description: A fresh UUID per hold (at least 16 characters without an API key). The same key and request within 24 hours return the same hold; without a key that repeat says only that the hold exists and its state.

nationality.description: Guest nationality, ISO 3166 alpha-2 (prices can depend on it). Default from the client's language, else NL.

offer_id.description: offer_id from search_hotels or get_hotel. Enough on its own: Quub knows the hotel, dates, adults and currency it was issued for.

remarks.description: Special requests for the hotel, not guaranteed.

name: prebook
title: Hold a room
